props.title: Eighty-Five Days Without a Tweet. The Liquidity Pool Didn't Care.

props.text: Every crypto marketing guide says engage or die. A PLOS ONE study found the opposite — excessively high engagement correlated with lower token returns. Open-source maintainer research shows the same pattern: 80% of time spent on community management buries the actual building. MiroShark has been silent for 85 days while its LP grew 9x to $2.8M and its agent shipped code for 193 consecutive days. The engagement was never the load-bearing wall.
